results.title: LexisNexis Launches Skills in Lexis+® with ProtégéTM in Hong Kong, Advancing the Legal AI Solution Built on the Authority Legal Work Demands
results.description: HONG KONG , Aug. 24, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- LexisNexis ® Legal & Professional today announced the launch of skills in Lexis+ ® with ProtégéTM in Hong Kong, designed to help law firms, corporate legal departments and legal professionals complete complex legal work faster, with greater accuracy, consistency, confidence and control. The launch of Lexis+ ® with ProtégéTM in Hong Kong adds guided skills for complex legal work, grounded in LexisNexis legal content, user-uploaded files, CaseBase Hong Kong Citation Service and web sources. The legal AI market in Hong Kong is moving quickly. New solutions can generate text, summarise documents and automate isolated tasks. But legal work requires something more demanding: current, authoritative legal content; verification tools; a connection to user-uploaded files; governance for confidentiality and privilege; and workflows that reflect how lawyers practise. That distinction matters. AI without deep legal authority and built-in verification may accelerate work, but it can also heighten risk from invented citations and unsupported conclusions to inconsistent drafting, uncontrolled matter data and weak auditability. Lexis+ ® with ProtégéTM is built to address that reality, combining authoritative LexisNexis legal content, CaseBase Hong Kong Citation Service, user-uploaded files and web sources in one integrated platform so results are grounded, verified and traceable across the full arc of legal work. At the center of the Hong Kong launch are Skills in Lexis+ ® with ProtégéTM, a guided workflow capability that changes how lawyers use AI to complete complex tasks . Users can select a skill directly from the dropdown menu, after which Protégé presents a structured work plan rather than a single response, giving users visibility and control as it executes tasks and produces review-ready legal work product. The initial skills portfolio supports repeatable tasks across regulatory and compliance, corporate and commercial, litigation, pro bono, legal education and training, and general legal tasks. This allows legal teams to reuse proven workflows, apply firm and department standards consistently, and benefit from broader market innovation while keeping work grounded in authoritative LexisNexis content, user-uploaded files and trusted workflow safeguards. Lexis+ ® with ProtégéTM incorporates skills from LexisNexis and Anthropic, with additional skills and capabilities in development. Skills in Lexis+ ® with ProtégéTM help lawyers and legal teams create ready-to-use legal work outputs through guided, task-specific workflows. Current skills support high-value drafting, review and assessment tasks such as Draft Written Resolutions, Data Processing Agreement (DPA) Review, Privacy Impact Assessment (PIA) Generation and Demand Letter Intake & Assessment. Working from LexisNexis content, uploaded templates, selected files and matter materials, these skills help users produce context-aware drafts and responses in Microsoft Word for review, refinement and use in their existing process. New skills in Lexis+® with ProtégéTM guide users through structured workflows to produce review-ready work product grounded in LexisNexis legal content, user-uploaded files and matter materials. The Hong Kong launch comes as legal professionals are moving from experimentation to legal-grade execution. In a recent LexisNexis APAC AI Sentiment Survey* of Hong Kong legal professionals, AI adoption reached 96.5%, while 71.5% said they would use AI more if it came as guided workflows rather than open chat prompts. At the same time, accuracy and hallucination risk was the top concern, cited by 54.4% of respondents. The findings underscore why legal AI needs trusted sources, structured workflows and transparent verification. Protégé Vault gives legal professionals a secure intelligence layer for document-led matters. Teams can securely upload, store and analyse collections of matter materials in one workspace, preserving context across sessions for drafting, review and analysis. Outputs link back to source material where available so legal teams can verify findings and defend the work product that follows. Lexis+ ® with ProtégéTM also brings leading AI models into a secure LexisNexis workspace. Legal AI responses can be grounded in authoritative LexisNexis legal content, Practical Guidance, CaseBase Hong Kong Citation Service and user-uploaded files, while General AI can incorporate real-time web sources when broader context is required. This gives Hong Kong customers model flexibility and source control without forcing work into disconnected tools. For lawyers, the result is practical and immediate: faster research and drafting cycles, stronger first drafts, more consistent application of firm and client standards, reduced citation and review risk, better handling of matter files, and more secure collaboration between legal teams and clients. In the Hong Kong survey, 75.9% of respondents agreed AI can save time on lower-value work, 65.7% agreed it can help them operate their firm, practice or department more efficiently, and 62.3% agreed it can give their business a competitive advantage. Instead of forcing legal professionals to choose between speed and trust, Lexis+ ® with ProtégéTM brings both into a single legal AI platform. "Legal AI is moving from experimentation to trusted execution. For Hong Kong legal professionals, the next stage is not just faster answers, but connected workflows grounded in authoritative content, secure infrastructure and professional judgment. Lexis+ ® with ProtégéTM is built for that future, helping teams move from legal questions and documents to review-ready work product in one trusted environment," said Michael Sit, Managing Director, Greater China, LexisNexis Legal & Professional. Lexis+ ® with ProtégéTM Skills is now available in Hong Kong, with additional skills and capabilities planned over time. To learn more about Lexis+ ® with ProtégéTM: www.lexisnexis.com/en-hk/products-and-services/online-solution/lexis-plus-protege . *APAC AI Sentiment Report 2026 was based on over 1700 Legal Professionals. About LexisNexis ® Legal & Professional LexisNexis ® Legal & Professional provides AI-powered legal, regulatory, business information, analytics, and workflows that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. As a digital pioneer, the company was the first to bring legal and business information online with its Lexis ® and Nexis ® services. LexisNexis Legal & Professional, which serves customers in more than 150 countries with 11,900 employees worldwide, is part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers.
